verdict.rationale: No vendor documentation in the evidence pack describes a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out for AI-native users of Ashby's AI features (Assistant, MCP Server, Notetaker); the only related evidence is community reports that an AI opt-out form for candidates was broken and that email data was scraped without opt-out, indicating the capability is not delivered as expected. missing for 10: any first-party telemetry/opt-out settings documentation, a working opt-out mechanism, and confirmation this applies to AI-native product users rather than candidates.
